Hi {{lead.First Name:default= }},
We're sorry to have missed you at our webinar “The FX factor: Why cross-border payments can make or break your customer experience.”
In this webinar, Flywire’s Chris McCracken and Talent.com’s Maxime Laliberte discussed:
- Why the B2B payment experience impacts the overall customer experience - Why organizations like Talent.com looking to grow globally should consider their Accounts Receivable process as a key driver of business acceleration - How solving payments fuels global success
Watch the recording here! <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/webinar-the-fx-factor-why-cross-border-payments-can-make-or-break-your-customer-experience]]>
Want to learn more about Talent.com and Flywire? Check out our case study <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/case-study-talent-com-implements-flywire-to-drive-global-growth]]> and be sure to download our payer survey <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/b2b-payers-survey-report]]> to learn more.
Need more information or have questions? Please reach out to Chris McCracken: chris.mccracken@flywire.com <[[mailto:chris.mccracken@flywire.com]]>.
Thank you!
The Flywire Team Flywire Global Headquarters 141 Tremont Street, Boston, MA 02111 United States
